candidate.answerReason: Susan pays 60 dollars and Pam pays 70 dollars, so Pam pays 10 dollars more, agreeing with choice C.

methods.label: Compare the discounted totals
methods.explanation:
A \(25\%\) discount means Susan pays \(75\%\) of full price, while a \(30\%\) discount means Pam pays \(70\%\). Their total costs, in dollars, are
\[
4\cdot20\cdot0.75=60,
\qquad
5\cdot20\cdot0.70=70.
\]
Pam therefore pays \(70-60=10\) dollars more, choice \(C\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary percentage discounts and total-price arithmetic.
